title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash for longer agent and coding work
friendlyTitle: Google releases a faster model for coding and AI helpers
summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash as a faster, lower-cost model for multi-step reasoning, software engineering and long-running agents, alongside a restricted cybersecurity variant. The introductory API price matches 3.7 Flash, although Google says difficult tasks may consume more reasoning tokens.
friendlySummary: Gemini 3.8 Flash is designed for coding, careful reasoning and AI helpers that work through long tasks. It starts at the same price as the previous Flash model, but hard jobs may use more tokens.
whyItMatters: For teams building agents, model sticker price is only half the cost equation; reliability, tool use and total tokens per completed task matter too. The new effort controls give developers a practical way to trade depth for speed and spend.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make capable AI helpers cheaper to build. Teams should still measure the total cost of finishing a task, not only the price of each token.
